name: @skynot/studio
description: The studio: the browser side of skynot, which knows an office only through the contract.

scripts.build: npm run design:export && vite build && npm run github:export && vite build --config vite.github.config.ts
scripts.build:github: npm run design:export && npm run github:export && vite build --config vite.github.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:studio && playwright test -c e2e
